Latin word

jocus

jocus, jocī m. (pl. joca)

declension

joke, jest; a joke, jest

  • joke

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 7.11.3: remōtō jocō tibi hoc amīcissimō animō praecipiō; Plaut. Poen. 541: equidem haec vōbīs dīxī per jocum; Traupman 101: jocō remōtō; per jocum, inter jocum; Traupman 335

Examples

  • Nimis īrācundī estis: equidem haec vōbīs dīxī per jocum.

    You’re far too touchy: I only said it as a joke.Plaut. Poen. 541
